mode: open-source library, not the hosted platform, run through a JSON-lines bridge in mem0's own Python
door: Memory.search(query, filters={user_id: "adebench"}, top_k=20), one line per result with its metadata
model: gemini-3-flash-preview (Google, mem0's gemini provider): extracts memories from every add (infer=True, ADD-only)
storage: local Qdrant on disk (vectors, BM25 slot, entity collection), SQLite history
not_default: max_tokens 8192 instead of 2000 (the default counts Gemini 3's thinking tokens and cut extractions, items silently lost); Gemini provider for LLM and embedder instead of the OpenAI default, other cloud keys removed so nothing falls back to it; telemetry off (MEM0_TELEMETRY=False, reason not stated)
